title: Marketing for Concrete Contractors: Attract Better Jobs

facts.fact: Low Country Concrete, a client case study on the page, serves Savannah, Richmond Hill, and nearby communities.
facts.quote: Low Country Concrete serves Savannah, Richmond Hill, and nearby communities.

facts.fact: The vendor says it built a dedicated Savannah page for Low Country Concrete that features driveway replacements, patios, foundations, and commercial projects.
facts.quote: A dedicated Savannah page featuring driveway replacements, patios, foundations, and commercial projects.

facts.fact: The page recommends that a contractor take photos of one completed or ongoing project each week as a marketing routine.
